W.note: Nicest SVG marks and win highlight plus good a11y, but adds a computer opponent, scoreboard and loser-starts rule beyond 'basic', and the board rows visibly squash once marks appear.

X.note: Small, correct and clean with stable fixed-size cells, but screen-reader labels are just 'Cell n', there is no focus style, and the look is plain.

Y.note: Simple and correct with a nice thick-grid look and alternating starter, but rows squash when marks appear and labels are only 'Cell n'.

Z.note: Basic, correct, with descriptive row/column labels, aria-live status, dark mode, large touch targets, clear win highlight and stable layout.
